posts.title: Finding hills in a flat country with Phoenix and a Rust NIF
posts.description: Heuvelradar finds short, steep running loops in the Netherlands on half-metre AHN heights and works out how many laps reach your climb target. Here is how the search works and why it runs as Rust inside a Phoenix app.

posts.title: One report, rendered to HTML, PDF and Excel without a headless browser
posts.description: quario compiles a JSON report document once and renders it as HTML, a paginated PDF, an XLSX workbook, CSV or Word, with no Chromium in your container and no unsafe-eval.

posts.title: A JSONPath engine that follows the spec and can't run code
posts.description: padvinder is a 2.75KB, zero-dependency JSONPath engine: full RFC 9535 including filters, no eval, no new Function, and safe under a strict CSP.
